58K likes, 240 comments - easyjapanesecooking on July 28, 2026: "Healthy Chicken Meatball Soup 

Juicy chicken meatballs, tender cabbage, and a light, savory shirodashi broth make this an easy and comforting Japanese home-cooked meal. 

Ingredients
・250 g cabbage
・1 tsp sesame oil
Chicken Meatballs
・250 g ground chicken
・1/4 green onion, chopped
・1 tbsp potato starch
・1 tbsp sake
・1 tsp grated ginger
・1/4 tsp salt
Soup
・500 ml water
・3 tbsp shirodashi (10x concentrated)
・1 tbsp sake
・1/2 tsp chicken stock powder
Toppings
Green onion, black pepper, sesame seeds

Instructions
1. Mix the meatball ingredients until sticky.
2. Shape into bite-sized balls.
3. Bring the soup ingredients, to a boil.
4. Add the meatballs and cook for 4 minutes.
5. Add the cabbage and cook for 3 minutes.
6. Turn off the heat and add sesame oil.
7. Add toppings and enjoy!

#JapaneseFood #ChickenMeatballSoup #ToriDango #JapaneseCooking #EasyJapaneseRecipe #SoupRecipe #GroundChickenRecipe".
